summary.en: NAU's current official School of International Students page states that its non-degree education includes Chinese-language courses. The official site also publishes an individual online-application procedure and a tuition document with a language-student category, but no language-specific next intake, duration or current fee is announced.
summary.zh: 南京审计大学留学生院当前官网明确说明其非学历教育包含汉语课程；官网还公布个人在线申请流程及包含语言生类别的收费文件，但未公布下一轮汉语项目的具体周期、学制或当期学费。
summary.ru: Текущая официальная страница Института иностранных студентов NAU указывает курсы китайского языка в составе нестепенного обучения. Университет публикует порядок индивидуальной подачи и документ с категорией языковых студентов, однако следующий набор, длительность и актуальная стоимость не объявлены.

Стоимость — 38 000 юаней в год на китайском и 45 000 на английском; срок 30 июня 2026 года закрыт. Специальности определяются официальным каталогом.

summary.ru: Официальная страница NAU устанавливает 10 000 юаней в год бакалаврам и 20 000 магистрантам, с ежегодной подачей с 1 марта по 15 июля. На 2 августа 2026 года окно закрыто; это повторяющееся правило, а не отдельное объявление набора.

exclusions.reason: Hainan Medical University's current 2026 official international degree-student guide lists only the already-catalogued five-year Chinese-taught Clinical Medicine bachelor's program. A Traditional Chinese Medicine route appears only in the closed 2025 guide and was not re-announced in 2026, so it remains withheld as historical/stale rather than being presented as current. The two applicable scholarships are already catalogued.

Xizang University's current official non-degree guide and 2025 enrollment evidence confirm only the already-catalogued Tibetan-language general-study program. No second concrete, individually applicable international program or current school-specific scholarship application route was located on an official page.

Official materials mention Auditing, Accounting, Economics and International Trade across international bachelor/master education, but do not map Accounting, Economics or International Trade to a specific degree level and current individual intake. Those ambiguous degree identities were withheld; only the explicit current Chinese-language non-degree identity was emitted.

notes: Nanjing Audit University gains one explicit Chinese-language non-degree identity and a nonduplicate municipal-government scholarship.

Chengdu University of Traditional Chinese Medicine gains a current official 2026 self-funded doctoral route plus Sichuan and Chengdu government freshman scholarships; the 2026 program cycle is closed.
Hainan Medical University and Xizang University remain single-current-program institutions because no second current high-confidence program could be verified.
No domestic-student catalog was used, no dynamic value was guessed, and no expired cycle is marked open.
